cases.question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.standalone_question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.answer_excerpt:
**COMP 4537: Internet Software Architecture** is a 3-credit course focused on the design, development, and management of web APIs. It teaches students how to build secure, scalable, and well-documented backend services using modern web standards.

### Key Topics Covered
* **RESTful APIs:** Understanding what RESTful APIs are, why they matter, and how they relate to HTTP.
* **Core Operations and Constraints:** Working with CRUD operations, REST constraints, and HTTP status codes.
* **API Security:** Securing backend API servers, implementing error handling, and managing database security following the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP).
* **Development and Tools:** Designing web services using REST, JSON, and HTTP, as well as practicing change management and API versioning.

### Course Details
* **Prerequisites:** COMP 1537 and COMP 3522.
* **Program:** Offered as a common course in Level 4 of the Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma (Full-time).
* **Delivery:** 3 hours per week of lectures over 15 weeks (45 total hours).
* **Grading Criteria:** 
  * Mid-term Exam: 30%
  * Final Exam: 30%
  * Quizzes: 15%
  * Assignments: 10%
  * Group Projects: 10%
  * Class Participation: 5%

### Sources
* https://www.bcit.ca/courses/internet-software-architecture-comp-4537/
* https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261088086/
* https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/

cases.question: How much is the commitment fee for international students at BCIT?
cases.standalone_question: How much is the commitment fee for international students at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
The commitment fee for international students at BCIT is **$6,000**. 

This fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. It is required to confirm your acceptance and secure your seat once you are offered admission into a full-time program or a Flexible Learning program. 

Key details regarding this fee include:
* **Application to Tuition:** The $6,000 commitment fee is applied directly toward your tuition upon registration.
* **Flexible Learning Conversion:** If you have already registered and paid for Flexible Learning courses in the same term as your application, BCIT will convert those tuition payments into your commitment fee (up to the maximum of $6,000).
* **Forfeiture:** The fee is forfeited and retained by BCIT if you decline the offer after making the payment, or if you do not register for any courses in your start term.
* **Study Permit:** Once paid, international students will receive the official Letter of Acceptance (LOA) required to apply for a Canadian study permit.

cases.question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.standalone_question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.answer_excerpt:
### BCITSA Health and Dental Plan Automatic Enrollment
You are automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan if you are registered in a BCIT program designated as full-time that is at least 16 weeks in length. If you meet these criteria, the Student Association Health fee is automatically included in your tuition upon registration. Students in ISEP or part-time (flexible learning) programs are not eligible for automatic enrollment.

### BCITSA Health and Dental Plan Opt Out
Yes, you can opt out of the plan. If you already have comparable extended health and dental coverage, you have the option to decline the student plan. 

To opt out, you must submit your request before the deadline, which is strictly **30 days from the start of your program**. This opt-out is processed once every 12 months, and no opt-out requests can be processed after the deadline has passed.

### BCIT English Category 1 IELTS Score Requirement
To meet BCIT English Language Proficiency Category 1 using the International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Academic test, you must achieve an **overall score of 7.0**, with no individual band score less than 6.0. 

### International Student Commitment Fee
The commitment fee for international students is **$6,000**. This non-refundable fee is required to confirm your acceptance and secure your seat in a full-time or Flexible Learning program. Once you register, this fee is applied directly toward your tuition.

### Sources

* https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/international-fees/
* https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/

cases.question: Three quick questions: is peer tutoring free, can I opt out of the BCITSA health and dental plan, and what student residences are on the Burnaby campus?
cases.standalone_question: Is BCIT peer tutoring free, can I opt out of the BCITSA health and dental plan, and what student residences are on the Burnaby campus?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Here are the answers to your three questions:

### 1) BCIT Peer Tutoring Cost and Fees
Yes, peer tutoring is completely free and available to all BCIT students. 

### 2) BCITSA Health and Dental Plan Opt-Out
Yes, you can opt out of the BCITSA Student Health and Dental Plan if you already have comparable extended health and dental coverage. To do so, you must submit your opt-out request within 30 days from the start of your program. This deadline occurs once every 12 months, and opt-outs cannot be processed after this date.

### 3) BCIT Burnaby Campus Student Housing Residences
The Burnaby campus offers the following student housing options:
* **Tall Timber Student Housing:** Opened in Fall 2025, this facility offers fully self-contained Studio rooms and Connected Single rooms.
* **Legacy Townhouses:** These accommodate 12 students each in private rooms with shared common facilities.

Sources:

* https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/
* https://www.bcit.ca/student-services/student-life-housing/

COMP 2714 is worth 4.0 credits and requires COMP 1712 as a prerequisite. COMP 4537 is worth 3.0 credits and does not require COMP 1712.

* **COMP 4537 (Internet Software Architecture):** 
  * This course is worth **3.0 credits**.

cases.question: Which English proficiency categories does BCIT use for admissions?
cases.follow_up: What TOEFL iBT score does Category 2 require?
cases.standalone_question: What TOEFL iBT score does BCIT English proficiency Category 2 require?

prior_turns.question: Which English proficiency categories does BCIT use for admissions?

cases.answer_excerpt:
To meet the Category 2 English language proficiency requirement, the required TOEFL iBT score depends on your program's start date:

*   **For programs starting prior to January 21, 2026:** You need an overall score of 86, with no section score less than 20.
*   **For programs starting as of January 21, 2026:** You need an overall score of 4.5, with minimum section scores of 3.5 in Speaking, 3.5 in Writing, 3.5 in Reading, and 3.5 in Listening.

Please note that your test results must be dated no more than two years before your program's start date.

Sources:
* https://www.bcit.ca/admission/entrance-requirements/english-language-proficiency/
